decisions.reason: Adding the ISBN specifically to the copyright page does not alter title-page content or layout.
The copyright-page ISBN addition does not affect dedication-page content.
The source decision does not change chapter-image inclusion, placement, timing, or treatment.
Adding an ISBN to the copyright page does not affect Mama's Hot Take styling.
The source decision has no effect on chapter-image aspect ratio, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
The ISBN addition is confined to copyright-page content and does not change body-text spacing or page density.
The copyright-page change does not alter chapter-title or subtitle formatting.
The source decision does not affect the editorial review or selection of chapter images.
The instruction to place an ISBN on the copyright page does not change the existing obligation to provide ISBN, copyright, or publication-readiness guidance.
The client explicitly targets the copyright page, not the paperback cover or its presentation.
The source requests ISBN placement on the copyright page and does not modify KDP metadata entry or upload support.
The copyright-page ISBN addition does not change the manuscript's editorial polishing or proofreading requirements.
